title: Fish Speech TTS backend and example page
description: Implement Fish Speech backend using mlx-audio on Apple Silicon and PyTorch on Linux GPU workers, create the example comparison page at /examples/fish, and document licensing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented Fish Speech TTS backend across CLI and worker-image with voice resolution, breaks support, local cache checking to prevent download hangs, and synthetic fallback. Created /examples/fish comparison page and updated ModelCompareNav with 6 models. Verified with unit tests, behave scenarios, and Playwright acceptance tests. Generated and uploaded audio for Gettysburg excerpt (f7fee97f).
